author: Meeting C++
description:
Meeting C++ starts with its yearly public recording events for the online track!

The public prerecordings for Meeting C++ 2026 are starting!

by Jens Weller

From the article:

As a hybrid conference Meeting C++ 2026 will feature an online only track. And you already are able to attend these talks prior to the conference!

The public prerecordings are meant to have an audience, and these are the first three events scheduled, all with 2-3 talks in one afternoon:
Tuesday, 27th October 15:00 (public Meetup Event)

15:20 Johan Vanslembrouck - Distributed programming with coroutines and asynchronous communication frameworks
16:40 Amlal El Mahrouss - Low-Level C++, Theory and Applications
Tuesday, 3rd November 13:45 (public Meetup Event)

14:00 Alexe
title: The public prerecordings for Meeting C++ 2026 are starting!
